# Rump Labs

> Rump Labs is a technical services firm. It acts as the technical half of a
> founder's company: technical consultancy, POC and MVP development, delivery
> management, technical distribution, AI automation, and Web3 / zero-knowledge
> engineering. Every engagement is scoped in writing, with a fixed price agreed
> before work starts, and is measured in days or weeks rather than quarters.

Rump Labs is based in India and works global hours. The defining commitment is
ownership: from day one the client holds the GitHub repository, the cloud
account, the API keys and the domain, so an engagement can end at any point
without the client losing access to what they paid for. Architectural decisions
are recorded as an ADR log the client keeps. Acceptance is a passing test suite
or an agreed evaluation threshold, not an opinion.

Rump Labs also runs Rump Gurukul, a zero-knowledge proofs course, which is the
firm's evidence for its cryptography claims rather than a separate business.

## Services

Five fixed-shape engagements. Each has a written boundary, a delivery date, and
a guarantee that costs Rump Labs money if the estimate was wrong. Prices are
quoted on the introductory call.

- The Technical Brief: a written technical read on the product, delivered in
  three business days. Recommended architecture, build sequence, the decisions
  that matter, a real cost and time range, and named risks with a mitigation
  against each. The client keeps the document whether or not they hire the firm.
- Fractional CTO: a monthly retainer with a capped, tracked number of hours.
  Architecture, hiring input, code and PR review, and a monthly written record
  of every technical decision and its reasoning. Rolling, 30 days notice.
- One Workflow, Automated: one repeated manual process built and deployed as an
  automation in ten business days, on the client's infrastructure, with failure
  handling, a runbook and a walkthrough recording.
- Contract Sprint: one Solidity contract written to spec, or one contract of up
  to 500 lines torn down line by line with findings graded by severity. Twelve
  business days. Explicitly pre-audit work, not a formal audit.
- POC Sprint: one demo-able feature — one user, one path, one outcome — built
  and deployed to a live URL in three weeks from scope-lock, with a repository
  and a recorded demo run.

If a build is larger than these shapes, Rump Labs says so in writing on the
first call with an honest range, and either declines or sequences the work into
gated phases rather than hiding the true size inside smaller invoices.

## What Rump Labs does not do

- Compliance-certified healthcare or financial systems (HIPAA, SOC 2)
- 24/7 on-call SRE rotations
- Mobile app store release management and review appeals
- Staff augmentation or embedded headcount on a client org chart
- Quarter-long enterprise programmes

## Rump Gurukul

- A ten-week certification cohort on zero-knowledge proofs in blockchain,
  starting January 2026.
- Two live lectures a week, Saturdays and Sundays, 11:00-13:00 IST, two hours
  each. Every session is recorded.
- No prerequisites and no prior coding or cryptography knowledge required.
- Syllabus: cryptographic foundations and elliptic curves; interactive proofs
  including Schnorr and Bulletproofs; modern proof systems Groth16, PLONK and
  STARKs plus recursive frameworks Halo2, Nova and SuperNova; lookup arguments,
  sum-check protocols and KZG commitments; ZK-Rollups, ZK-EVMs, ZK-VMs and
  ZK-Bridges with case studies from zkSync, StarkNet, Polygon and Succinct Labs;
  circuit development in Circom, Halo2, Noir, Leo and ZoKrates; confidential
  applications on Aztec; and a final group project presentation.
- Includes group projects, project presentations, a completion certificate,
  course materials, job referrals where they can be made, and an internship
  track at Rump Labs based on performance.
- Taught by Hridam Basu, founder of Rump Labs, a cryptography researcher and
  engineer with over a decade in the blockchain industry. Previously worked with
  the Ethereum Foundation's Privacy and Scaling Explorations team, Polygon,
  Aztec, Findora, Circularise and Bolt Labs, and held research roles at AT&T
  Labs, NTT Labs and TCS Labs. Invited speaker at Devcon and at universities
  internationally. M.S. Computer Science, Northeastern University; B.E.
  Information Technology, Jadavpur University.
- Pricing is location-aware. Early-bird enrolment in India is ₹20,000 (down
  from ₹25,000). The fee is shown on the enrolment page.
